{{Recipe}}

'''Carrot juice''' is a refreshing beverage that is best enjoyed cold.

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Carrot|Carrots]]
* [[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
* [[Cookbook:Water|Water]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Grater|Grater]]
* [[Cookbook:Blender|Blender]]
* [[Cookbook:Sieve|Strainer]]
* [[Cookbook:Knife|Knife]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Chopping|Chop]] or [[Cookbook:Grating|grate]] the carrots.
# Place carrots and sugar in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]], and add a small amount of water as needed.
# Blend this mixture until well-puréed.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the carrot purée to obtain a pure juice.
# Chill and serve.
